instruction: A standing stone monument: a tall rough-hewn upright monolith with an irregular weathered surface, patches of lichen coloring, and a subtle lean, set into a low grassy ground base. Real-world units, believable menhir scale.
user_instruction: Build a single-file three.js scene of a standing stone monument. A standing stone monument: a tall rough-hewn upright monolith with an irregular weathered surface, patches of lichen coloring, and a subtle lean, set into a low grassy ground base. Real-world units, believable menhir scale. Make it procedural from three.js geometry with realistic proportions, materials and lighting, and orbit controls.
